== Description ==

[[Amar Banger]] (front left (back), olive Nike hoodie, hair bun), [[Nathan Davis]] (back left, blue/yellow M cap, black hoodie, beard), [[Ryan Jellison]] (front right (back), dark brown pullover, jeans), and [[Mike Turner]] (back right, tan eagle cap, black galaxy hoodie) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 3 October 2025.
